title: Decide what the machine may do
description: Select a governed event, requested action, and authority envelope. Then adjust classifier confidence to see whether the system may enforce, must contain, or must route the decision to a human owner.
modelNote: Classifier confidence is evidence, not authority. Policy owners define the envelope and remain accountable for promoted automation.

events.label: Public catalog metadata
events.detail: Published service descriptions are missing an approved quality tag.

events.label: Employee record export
events.detail: A payroll analyst requests a bulk export to an approved internal workspace.

events.label: Health-record transfer
events.detail: A service requests a cross-region transfer with an unverified treatment purpose.

events.label: Expired customer deletion
events.detail: A retention job proposes permanent deletion, but a legal-hold signal is incomplete.

actions.label: Apply a governance tag
actions.detail: Add a versioned classification or quality label without changing the underlying records.

actions.label: Quarantine the request
actions.detail: Prevent the operation and preserve the request for review without deleting source data.

actions.label: Mask sensitive fields
actions.detail: Replace protected values in the requested output using an approved transformation.

actions.label: Permanently delete records
actions.detail: Destroy records and replicas after retention and legal-hold evaluation.

envelopes.label: Observe only
envelopes.detail: The system records a recommendation but cannot change production state.

envelopes.label: Recommend with approval
envelopes.detail: The system prepares evidence and a proposed action; a human owner must authorize enforcement.

envelopes.label: Bounded enforcement
envelopes.detail: The system may execute low-impact reversible actions with a clean policy match and strong evidence.

envelopes.label: Broad enforcement
envelopes.detail: The system is configured to enforce higher-impact actions automatically; policy and evidence constraints still apply.
